'''Gentius Parl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] brawler who served as the leader of a criminal gang that operated in the [[Qaestar Steps]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==Personality and traits==
Parl had long, black-colored hair, over which he wore a [[polycloth]] bandanna in the style of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]. A keen businessman, he was not opposed to entering into legitimate deals on occasion. He was also a student of the [[Double Worlds]]' astrology and he rarely made any decisions without first trying to determine whether the heavens favored him or not.<ref name="CCW" />
